initial.reason: Monomer1 is a bis-glycidyl aromatic epoxide (two oxirane rings present as OCC1OC1 and OCC4OC4) providing rigid, aromatic backbone to raise Tg toward 175°C and multifunctional epoxide sites to increase crosslink density (higher Er). Monomer2 is diethylenetriamine (NCCNCCN) containing multiple NC (amine) functionalities (two NC motifs within the string) to react with epoxide rings via ring-opening; the polyamine functionality ensures dense crosslinking and compatibility with epoxy groups. The epoxy (C1OC1/C4OC4)–amine (NC) chemistry is compatible for thermoset formation; the combination (rigid aromatic diglycidyl + multi-amine curing agent) is selected to approach the target high Tg (~175°C) and high modulus (Er ~100) through aromatic content and high crosslink density.
